segments.he: בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת — לוֹקְחִין תֵּיבָה. אָמַר רַבִּי שְׁמוּאֵל בַּר נַחְמָנִי אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹנָתָן: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת שֶׁל כְּפָרִים, אֲבָל בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת שֶׁל כְּרַכִּין, כֵּיוָן דְּמֵעָלְמָא אָתוּ לֵיהּ — לָא מָצוּ מְזַבְּנִי לֵיהּ, דְּהָוֵה לֵיהּ דְּרַבִּים.
segments.en: § The mishna states: If they sold «a synagogue, they may purchase an ark.» The Gemara cites a qualification to this halakha: «Rabbi Shmuel bar Naḥmani said» that «Rabbi Yonatan said: They taught» this «only» with regard to «a synagogue of a village,» which is considered the property of the residents of that village. «However,» with regard to «a synagogue of a city, since» people «come to it from the» outside «world,» the residents of the city «are not able to sell it, because it is» considered to be the property «of the public» at large and does not belong exclusively to the residents of the city.
